text:
Concept: Martian Southern Summer
Description: The period of Mars southern hemisphere summer, from southern summer solstice to southern autumn equinox: solar longitude 270 to 360 degrees. Coincides with perihelion season, warmer temperatures, and elevated dust activity.
Also known as: southern summer, southern hemisphere summer, martian summer, southern warm season
Type: Season
Grounds to these fields:
  ls_range -> Time_Coordinates.solar_longitude: {'min': 270, 'max': 360, 'unit': 'deg'}

Concept: Martian Northern Summer
Description: The period of Mars northern hemisphere summer, from northern summer solstice to northern autumn equinox: solar longitude 90 to 180 degrees. Falls within the cooler aphelion half of the Mars year.
Also known as: northern summer, northern hemisphere summer, northern warm season
Type: Season
Grounds to these fields:
  ls_range -> Time_Coordinates.solar_longitude: {'min': 90, 'max': 180, 'unit': 'deg'}

Concept: Martian Dust Storm Season
Description: The dusty half of the Mars year spanning southern spring and summer, solar longitude 180 to 360 degrees, when regional and global dust storms are most likely. Brackets perihelion.
Also known as: dust storm season, dusty season, storm season, peak dust season
Type: Season
Grounds to these fields:
  ls_range -> Time_Coordinates.solar_longitude: {'min': 180, 'max': 360, 'unit': 'deg'}

Concept: Mars Aphelion
Description: The point in Mars orbit farthest from the Sun, near solar longitude 71 degrees (late northern spring). Associated with cooler temperatures and the aphelion cloud belt.
Also known as: aphelion, mars aphelion, aphelion passage, farthest from sun, aphelion cloud belt season, aphelion season
Type: Orbital event
Grounds to these fields:
  ls_range -> Time_Coordinates.solar_longitude: {'min': 50, 'max': 90, 'unit': 'deg'}

Concept: Mars Perihelion
Description: The point in Mars orbit closest to the Sun, near solar longitude 251 degrees (southern spring). Associated with a warmer southern hemisphere and peak dust storm risk.
Also known as: perihelion, mars perihelion, perihelion passage, closest to sun, perihelion season
Type: Orbital event
Grounds to these fields:
  ls_range -> Time_Coordinates.solar_longitude: {'min': 230, 'max': 270, 'unit': 'deg'}

Concept: Mars Year
Description: Mars Year numbering system, where MY1 began April 1955. Used to reference specific observing periods, e.g. MY34 refers to the 2018 global dust storm year.
Also known as: MY34, MY33, MY35, mars year 34, mars year 33, 2018 dust storm year, 2018 global storm
Type: Temporal interval

Concept: Global Dust Storm
Description: A planet-encircling dust event on Mars where dust optical depth (tau) exceeds approximately 3, obscuring the surface globally. Notable events: MY25 (2001), MY34 (2018).
Also known as: global dust storm, planet-encircling dust event, global dust event, dust storm MY34, 2018 dust storm, MY25 dust storm, 2001 dust storm, tau surge, opacity surge, high dust opacity
Type: Atmospheric event
Grounds to these fields:
  opacity -> Radiometric_Correction.atmospheric_opacity: {'min': 3.0, 'unit': 'tau'}
Occurs during: Martian Dust Storm Season

Concept: Regional Dust Storm
Description: A localized dust storm on Mars affecting a region but not planet-encircling. Dust optical depth elevated but below global storm threshold.
Also known as: regional dust storm, local dust storm, dust event, elevated dust, dust lifting, dust opacity event
Type: Atmospheric event
Grounds to these fields:
  opacity -> Radiometric_Correction.atmospheric_opacity: {'min': 1.0, 'max': 3.0, 'unit': 'tau'}
Occurs during: Martian Dust Storm Season

Concept: Water Ice Clouds
Description: Water ice clouds on Mars that form primarily during the aphelion cloud belt season (Ls 50-150 degrees) near the equator.
Also known as: water ice clouds, ice clouds, aphelion cloud belt, ACB, martian clouds, equatorial clouds, cloud belt, cloud opacity
Type: Atmospheric event
Grounds to these fields:
  seasonal_window -> Time_Coordinates.solar_longitude: {'min': 50, 'max': 150, 'unit': 'deg'}
Occurs during: Mars Aphelion

Concept: SHARAD Radargrams
Description: Subsurface radar sounding data from the SHARAD instrument on MRO. Used to image subsurface layering, polar deposits, and ice. Data type is radargram.
Also known as: sharad, subsurface radar, ice penetrating radar, ground penetrating radar mars, radar sounder, subsurface sounder, radargram, radar cross section, stratigraphic profiles from orbit
Type: Instrument
Grounds to these fields:
  instrument_name -> Instrument.name: {'value': 'SHARAD'}
  mission_name -> Mission_PDS3.mission_name: {'value': 'MARS RECONNAISSANCE ORBITER'}

Concept: CRISM Hyperspectral Imaging
Description: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars on MRO. Maps surface mineralogy. Modes include FRT (full resolution targeted) and HRL (half-resolution long).
Also known as: crism, hyperspectral, spectrometer MRO, mineralogy mapper, FRT, HRL, targeted spectrometer, surface composition mapping, spectral imaging
Type: Instrument
Grounds to these fields:
  instrument_name -> Instrument.name: {'value': 'CRISM'}
  mission_name -> Mission_PDS3.mission_name: {'value': 'MARS RECONNAISSANCE ORBITER'}

Concept: Curiosity Rover Science Phase
Description: The primary science operations phase of the MSL Curiosity rover, beginning after landing in August 2012 and continuing through the mission.
Also known as: curiosity science, MSL science phase, curiosity rover data, gale crater science, post-landing science, sol-based observations, curiosity surface operations
Type: Mission phase
Grounds to these fields:
  phase_name -> Mission_Phase.mission_phase_name: {'value': 'PRIMARY SURFACE MISSION'}
  mission_name -> Mission_PDS3.mission_name: {'value': 'MARS SCIENCE LABORATORY'}
